notes.grade: The Ssarathi royal archive (registry ssarathi_royal_archive) declares an enabled sun for its open undercroft mouth, so the look grades it. Measured in Forward+ at the spawn (55, 39), pitch -60 and -30, against develop's compatibility frame. Untrimmed, the jade floor went darker and greyer: luma 40 to 27, saturation 0.68 to 0.49. exposure_forward 1.4 and saturation_forward 1.35 put it back at 37 and 0.66 (1.25 and 1.4 gave 34 and 0.65). The compatibility renderer was not measured, so it keeps the defaults.
notes.sky: sky.paint 0 (integration): the painted sky and its haze are off here, so the void keeps the binder's own sky; the grade still runs. With the sky layer on, the void beyond the archive's walls was a lit sky and haze (luma 128 at the play camera, 196 at the low view, where develop draws a dark brown of 53 and 55), made a little brighter still by the exposure trim above.
